answer: To wander across many fake identities, an attacker must fund every bond, and each failed challenge burns it to an ember, leaving only cold basalt where capital once sat. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must stake a persistent bond locked to a hardware-attested key, and peers randomly challenge it to sign a fresh nonce. Rotating identities costs the full stake repeatedly, making mass sybils economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
